neet_phy_u20_t01_1.working: The ratchet slips once the studs grip the wire with a set pressure. This holds the wire with uniform pressure without compressing it.

neet_phy_u20_t01_2.working: LC = 0.5/50 = 0.01 mm. A circular-scale zero below the reference line is a positive zero error of +4 × 0.01 = +0.04 mm. Observed reading = 1.5 + 36 × 0.01 = 1.86 mm. Corrected diameter = 1.86 − 0.04 = 1.82 mm.

neet_phy_u20_t01_4.working: Pitch is the distance moved per rotation (II). Least count is pitch divided by the number of divisions (III). The ratchet gives uniform pressure (IV). Backlash is avoided by turning in one direction only (I).

neet_phy_u20_t01_5.working: A is true: a zero below the reference line is a positive error. B is true: 1/100 = 0.01 mm. C is false: a negative zero error makes the true reading larger than observed. D is true. E is false: backlash is avoided by turning in one direction only.
